requests.prompt: Create one full-body ChronoStick Pinocchio, the wooden puppet from the fairy tale, in one vertical 9:16 illustration. The supplied style image controls the drawing language only. Give him a large circular pale wooden head, two tiny black dot eyes, one small closed curved mouth, a tiny short wooden nose and a dark forelock. His torso, arms and legs are slender stick shapes with small round elbow and knee joints. His simplified hands are pale mittens. His height is about 5.2 head diameters, with narrow shoulders. He wears a muted mustard cap with one burgundy feather, cream short-sleeve shirt, small brown vest, dusty-blue bow, burgundy shorts and brown rounded shoes. Show exactly one puppet standing in a relaxed three-quarter pose, fully visible with space above the cap and below the feet. Warm gray studio wall and floor, soft light from upper left. Dark drawn contours, matte illustrated surfaces and restrained period colors across the whole frame. One character, one scene, no lettering, collage or panels.
